SR-5.2.covers: pedestrian clearing speed Sp by crossing type: 1.2 standard/coordinated-lane, 1.0 high-demand / LRT-crossing / near institutions

SR-5.3.covers: bicycle speeds SX=25, SY=15, SZ=25 kph

SR-5.4.covers: LRT speeds: SX/SZ = max permitted section speed; SY = min(max(posted/2, 25), operational profile rounded up to 5)

SR-5.5.covers: clearing vehicle length: standard(+bus+truck)=12, articulated/coordinated/heavy-industry=19, bicycle=2, LRT=15

SR-5.3.6.covers: vehicle braking deceleration a=3.5 m/s²; slow-clearing acceleration a1 per §5.5

SR-5.3.7.covers: bicycles: constant speed, no acceleration; a=3.5 m/s²

SR-5.3.8.covers: LRT: a=1.2 m/s² max decel, a1=1.2 m/s² start acceleration

SR-5.3.9.covers: driver reaction time t=1.0 s for every vehicle type

SR-5.4.2.covers: L2/L3 measured from stop line to conflict point along travel-path centreline; multiple lanes → multiple candidate points; compute all when in doubt

SR-5.4.3.covers: vehicle clears vs ped/bike enters: T3=0; L2 to far edge of crossing (farther of ped/bike crossings)

SR-5.4.4.covers: ped clears vs vehicle enters: L3 to near side of crossing, <1.5m → 0; W at crossing centre incl. ped-bike gap, take longer

SR-5.5.1.covers: vehicle clearing: T2X=t+LX/Sx; a1Y=1.5-1.5*SY/50; T2Y quadratic; T2=max(T2X,T2Y); LX=L1X+L2+l, L1X=Sx²/2a

SR-5.5.3.covers: pedestrian: Tw=W/Sp; pedestrian entering time always 0

SR-5.5.5.covers: bicycle: T2X=t+LX/Sx, T2Y=t+LY/Sy constant speed; T3=L3/Sz; l=2

SR-5.6.covers: final: veh→veh/bike/LRT T=max(3,T2-T3); veh→ped T=max(3,T2); ped→veh T=max(3,Tw-T3)
